mapper.sql: SELECT rr.repair_id, rr.repair_no, rr.reporter_name, rr.contact_phone, rr.repair_address, rt.type_name AS repair_type_name, rr.description, e.employee_name, rr.evaluation, rr.expected_time, rr.status, rr.create_time, rr.dispatch_time, rr.complete_time, rr.complete_remark, rr.complete_image_url, rr.rating_score, rr.rating_time, rr.rating_content FROM repair_record rr LEFT JOIN repair_type rt ON rr.repair_type_id = rt.type_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON rr.employee_id = e.employee_id

where.if: AND (rr.repair_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rr.reporter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rr.contact_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rr.repair_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rr.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
